name: cinlink
description: Use CinLink media tools through the standalone CLI.

tools.name: cinlink_configure
tools.description: Store a CinLink API key for later hosted tool calls.

tools.name: cinlink_doctor
tools.description: Check hosted runtime health and local dependency status before local-only tasks.

tools.name: cinlink_setup_local_deps
tools.description: Prompt for or install CinLink local dependencies such as ffmpeg and optional voice-separation/enhancement components.

tools.name: cinlink_agent_run
tools.description: Submit a natural-language media task with current-input priority, canonical media intent, slot provenance, and localized structured clarification.

tools.name: cinlink_agent_clarify
tools.description: Collect all structured answers, including exact file/image selections, then continue once; runtime dubbing-reference choices resume the original run in place.

tools.name: cinlink_agent_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an active CinLink agent run and ignore any late local result.

tools.name: cinlink_agent_events
tools.description: Read public planning and reasoning events for a hosted CinLink agent run.

tools.name: cinlink_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe a local media file into subtitles.

tools.name: cinlink_translate
tools.description: Translate subtitles or media; local video input is converted to audio before hosted upload.

tools.name: cinlink_add_subtitles
tools.description: App-parity workflow: transcribe or translate subtitles, then burn them into a local video.

tools.name: cinlink_dub
tools.description: Generate dubbed speech/audio from local audio extraction plus subtitles and optional speaker reference audio.

tools.name: cinlink_burn
tools.description: Burn styled subtitles and optional watermarks into a local video with ffmpeg.

tools.name: cinlink_apply_watermark
tools.description: Apply a saved Brand Kit or one-off text/image watermark to a local video.

tools.name: cinlink_enhance_image
tools.description: Enhance a local image to a lossless PNG with the CinLink waifu2x component.

tools.name: cinlink_enhance_video
tools.description: Enhance a local video frame by frame while preserving its audio.

tools.name: cinlink_trim_video
tools.description: Cut a precise timestamp range from a local video.

tools.name: cinlink_montage
tools.description: Combine selected local video ranges into an ordered montage.

tools.name: cinlink_clean_cut
tools.description: Plan indexed long-pause removals, ask the user to approve them, then export only the selected local ranges.

tools.name: cinlink_brand_kit
tools.description: Show or configure the persistent caption and watermark Brand Kit.

tools.name: cinlink_mix_dubbed_audio
tools.description: Mix dubbed audio with the original local video audio.

tools.name: cinlink_summarize
tools.description: Summarize local video/audio/subtitles; full videos stay local and only extracted audio is uploaded.

tools.name: cinlink_shorten
tools.description: Create a localized highlight plan from account-scoped cloud-referenced audio, honoring explicit clip-selection preferences and retaining the local source path.

tools.name: cinlink_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a prompt and up to three local or remote reference images.

tools.name: cinlink_video
tools.description: Generate a video from a prompt and optional local or remote references.

tools.name: cinlink_deconstruct_video
tools.description: Turn a local video into an editable hosted shot-deconstruction plan with language and analysis-scope controls.

tools.name: cinlink_regenerate_deconstruction
tools.description: Regenerate a deconstruction plan shot by shot with optional visual replacements.

tools.name: cinlink_export_video
tools.description: Export a local video as MP4, MOV, AVI, or MKV.

tools.name: cinlink_export_audio
tools.description: Export local video or replacement audio as WAV or MP3.

tools.name: cinlink_export_editor_project
tools.description: Create a local CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, or Resolve project handoff.

tools.name: cinlink_nlu
tools.description: Route a natural-language media task to a CinLink action.
